reviews.t: Try Tree hut sugar scrub better (Coconut)
reviews.x: I didn’t like this product, seeing as it was a dry scrub that crumbled In my hand. I had to add my dove body wash to make it a better consistency to be able to use. And the strawberry smell is always a hit or miss with me. I’m a huge strawberry fan. But I didn’t really like this product specifically. Nothing was wrong with it, just wasn’t what I preferred. Hope this helps someone.

reviews.t: Sugary Sweet Treat for Your Skin
reviews.x: This body scrub is just as titled: exfoliating, sweet, and strawberry-scented. If you're looking for a sugary treat for your skin, this is a great option. It was a lovely way for full body relaxation. My skin is still soft and moisturized a day later. The strawberry scent doesn't smell artificial, but be aware the strawberry scent is very strong.

This product reminds me the texture of a coffee scrub but it isn’t very harsh. It actually pretty gentle on the skin. The smell is artificial strawberry and it’s a very light scent the smell isn’t very powerful. I’ve been using it over a week and it leaves my skin soft.

reviews.t: Light Yummy Light Scent!  Leaves your skin Soooo Very Soft & Moisturized!
reviews.x: Light Yummy scent!  (like a Strawberry Milk Shake*)  Leaves your skin Soooo Very Soft & Moisturized!  I will definitely buy again!  This product is SO VERY GOOD---I am so very curious about their other products!  You feel so soft, moist & exfoliated - without any greasy after feel. I am so very happy with this vendor & this product!  Wyoming Winters are so drying, so are the summers as far as that goes-lol.  I also use Dove's Pomegranate Cream Body Scrub.  I have mature skin(60+), so dryness is

I have been using Dove body polish ever since it came out and I love it, but I decided to try something different. That was not the best decision. The best thing about this scrub was the smell! It smelled like sweet strawberry candy. It had nice packaging and would look cute on display with the silver top and bright pink scrub. This scrub was incredibly abrasive. I was hoping this scrub was going to be more of a gel or soap-like consistency with the "scrubbers" in it.  This was more like a jar o

reviews.t: Rich in antioxidants and a soothing and moisturizing exfoliating body scrub.
reviews.x: My body has gotten so much drier over the last few years. So I was looking for an exfoliating, moisturizing body scrub and luckily found this one by Mostory.  The ingredients that are in it include Dead Sea Salt, strawberry extract, jojoba oil, sweet almond oil, vitamin A, vitamin E, hyaluronic acid and coconut oil all of which cause an amazing scent.  To use it you should wet your skin and apply a layer of body scrub gently massaging into your body with circular motions then thoroughly rinse yo

i LOVE the smell, but it’s not as rough or exfoliating as i like. it’s also more of a dry exfoliant so it gets a bit messy in the shower and i feel like it’s easier to waste product. other than that, it left my skin smooth and moisturized and the SMELL... omg. it smells so good! i’m so glad i picked strawberry. i was hoping it would have me smelling like strawberries all day but the scent didn’t last long after my shower. still love it though.

The package of this cream is very exquisite. It feels good to use. The particles are not big or small. The skin feels very comfortable. There were goose bumps before. After using it for several days, I feel that the skin is smoother and smoother than before. The smell is very good. There is a faint fragrance. It will continue to be used,

After using this scrub, skin feels very soft and smelt very pleasant. It does has a light smell of Strawberry and does give a good scrub. This is reasonably priced and the jar size is an added plus. I have seen other small jars sell at the more price. We don't have to use a lot, so the container should last a while.

reviews.t: Scent doesn't stay on skin, amazing moisture though
reviews.x: I was going to give this 4 stars because the scent DOES NOT stay on your skin (smells amazing though) but this does such an amazing job at moisturizing it deserves 5 stars. I was looking for a gentle scrub just for the smell but I was surprised at how amazing this was for my skin

reviews.t: Clean and fresh face every day
reviews.x: The MOSTORY sweet strawberry exfoliating scrub. Is a nice all natural exfoliating body scrub. The scent is nice not over powering. The exfoliating scrub helps leaves my face nice and clean removing excess dead skin and oils. After I use the scrub my face feels clean and smooth.

Thought I was getting a great deal for the price but nope. I liked the smell and color. Did not like the actual scrub. Mine arrived dried out and crumbly. I added some vitamin w oil and was able to use it. Highly disappointed in the one I received. will not order again.

This stuff smells amazing! Like sweet juicy strawberries. Yes it's a little small, but it's worth it. When I first opened it, it looked a bit dry. But once I scooped some out I found it to be very soft! No huge clumps grinding away as you try to run it... It's smooth.

This is a fantastic scrub! Honestly, one of the best I have ever used. The smell is delicious & smells just like strawberries. I appreciate that the ingredients are real & healthy, not a bunch of added junk! It also works well. It was moisturizing while exfoliating.

my friend is addicted to body scrubs , she loved the smell of this one. only thing is when it arrived alot of the oils had leaked out of the top.  she said it was still usable and she loved the way it went on. she said it made her feel silky smooth

I love the smell but not gonna lie it kind of hurts and stings the skin after use... I don’t think I’m necessarily using it roughly, it feels like it leaves micro cuts or something. I suppose it does leave my skin softer after use though lol

This was my first time purchasing and i was sooo happy about how it felt on my skin. Ive never had something make my skin feel so soft. I use this on my face also and it helps my dry skin! This is a product i WILL keep buying for sure!!

Smells great! But the sugar granules are kind of big so it can cause micro abrasions. If you use this before tanning, make sure to wash after because of the oil. Also, you can see some of the abrasions when you put the self tanner on.

reviews.t: Great except for the amount of product...
reviews.x: I wish there was more product for the price, but this works very well, leaves the skin smelling almost like a baby bottle pop! And it pairs very well with my morning face wash to really exfoliate and moisturize my skin.

Have been trying this scrub out for a few days, and my first comment is that I Love the scent! It's not too overpowering. The sugar scrub crystals are a nice size for exfoliating without being too harsh.

Me gusta que no esté grasoso como otros exfoliantes pero igual está muy seco. Apenas me lo aplico al cuerpo y se cae ni siquiera me da la oportunidad de exfoliarme. No estoy muy convencida del producto

reviews.t: Great smell, but not enough product
reviews.x: Good product. The smell is amazing! Your skin will definitely be very soft after just one use. The only downside is that the size of the jar is a lot smaller than expected. But overall good product.
I thought as an exfoliating scrub it wasn't doing much of anything for me but it left my body tub and anything else it touched super slippery, I almost fell due to it but it is very moisturizing.
At first the scrub looks like it will hurt to use because the Crystal's are large but it doesn't hurt, it has a good amount of scrubbing power. It smells awesome and leaves your skin hydrated.

reviews.t: Smells as good as it sounds.
reviews.x: I really love the smell of this scrub.  It's made of natural ingredients and smells like a strawberry shake.  Made my skin so soft.  My only suggestion is to  sell it in bigger containers.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant strawberry scent, describing it as sweet and not overpowering.
Many reviewers report that the scrub leaves skin soft and moisturized after use.
Several reviewers note the scrub is gentle and not overly harsh on the skin.
Some reviewers complain the scrub arrived dry or crumbly and required adding oil or body wash to make it usable.
A few reviewers mention packaging issues such as leaked oils or a small jar size.
